summary: Diff implements a $0.50 paywall UI, a frontend paid-access query, and backend storage for per-caller paid status (paidUsers + hasPaidAccess). Backend enforcement and payment-confirmation persistence are only partially evidenced due to truncation: recordIntake gating is visible, but getWeeklySummary gating and the backend confirmation endpoint that the frontend calls (confirmPurchase) are not shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Prevent unpaid users from fetching weekly summaries (getWeeklySummary must fail with a clear payment-required error for locked callers).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows recordIntake beginning to check paid status, but does not show any change to getWeeklySummary or any payment-required failure behavior for that method.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend payment confirmation flow must mark the authenticated caller as paid/unlocked after successful $0.50 payment (e.g., confirmPurchase implementation) and persist unlocked state.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.confirmPurchase(sessionId) and expects it to unlock the account, but the backend diff excerpt does not show a confirmPurchase method nor any code that sets paidUsers[caller] = true after verifying payment.

hallucinated_features.description: Added user profile management endpoints (getCallerUserProfile/getUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile) and a userProfiles map.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on paid access gating and payment flow; user profile storage/APIs were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced an authorization/access-control system with admin permissions and an admin-only Stripe configuration method (_initializeAccessControlWithSecret usage, setStripeConfiguration, accessControlState/mixin).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires authentication via Internet Identity for tying unlock state to Principal, but does not request an additional access-control/roles system or secret-token admin initialization flow.

hallucinated_features.description: Hydration storage schema migration to include timestamps in hydration records, plus an explicit backend migration module.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not request changing hydration record structure or adding timestamps; this appears to be an unrelated data model evolution (though it may be needed for upgrades).

hallucinated_features.description: Added general URL parameter/sessionStorage utilities and secret parameter handling for admin token retrieval.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of the paywall requirements; the build request does not mention URL param persistence utilities or secret admin tokens.
